name: Forest City Comicon
blurb: London, Ontario's original pop-culture convention, running for over a decade with comics, cosplay and tabletop gaming.
notes: The official site (both .com and .ca, same Wix build) still shows the Nov 2, 2025 edition as the latest news, with no 2026/2027 dates. London Tourism's own listing for the con explicitly says '2026 date and location: To be announced' (checked via WebFetch on 2026-10-05), so no upcoming edition is recorded.
